metadata.name: price-dynamics-tier2
metadata.description: Phase C.3 — price as a state relaxing toward Odum's ratio: dP/dt = alpha x (M/W - P). M is circulating money, W is delivered work (the C.2 low-pass tap), and the quotient is the C.1 ratio primitive with both operands named. Companion to emergent_price_model.json, which reaches a quantity PROPORTIONAL to M/W as the fixed point of two hand-tuned coefficients; this model computes the ratio itself. Both are kept so the difference stays visible in the suite.

_mechanism: Relaxation, not an algebraic reset (ADR 0005). P is a storage with two signal pathways, which is what a first-order lag looks like in ESL: a tank with an inflow and a drain. Inflow `p_target` is a ratio edge carrying alpha x M / W; outflow `p_relax` is a linear edge carrying alpha x P. Their difference is dP/dt = alpha x (M/W - P), whose fixed point is exactly M/W and whose approach time constant is 1/alpha. BOTH k values are alpha: if they differ the equilibrium becomes (k_in/k_out) x M/W, which is the proportional-only behaviour of the Tier 1 anchor reintroduced by accident. tests/test_price_dynamics.c asserts the fixed point equals M/W, which is the check that catches a mismatch.
_reading_M_and_W_without_consuming_them: An edge is a flow, so it debits its origin. `p_target` therefore originates at `unity`, a source: compute_derivatives pins sources to dQ/dt = 0, so the debit is discarded (ADR 0003). M and W reach the quotient as NAMED params instead — numerator_node and control_node — neither of which is consumed. That is what ADR 0002 meant by a ratio whose numerator and denominator are 'both named and distinguishable'.

carriers._note: Price and delivered work are signals, not stocks of a substance. Their pathways must stay out of the money and goods conservation checks.

nodes._note: Unlimited supply at the boundary; a source is not depleted.
Circulating money M. This is the numerator of the price ratio.
The scalar price is a poison value: if price_node resolution regresses the trajectory diverges obviously rather than subtly.

Delivered work (C.2): a low-pass storage fed by a tap that mirrors the trade flow and drained at beta. Starts at 10.0 rather than 0.0 so the very first step divides by a real W instead of riding the epsilon floor.
The emergent price P. Read by `ex` at every RK4 stage through price_node.
Pinned origin for the price inflow. Supplies topology, not magnitude: the flow is alpha x M / W and does not read this node's value at all.

edges._note: C.2 tap: reproduces the exchange flow F = k x Q_seller x Q_buyer off a pinned origin, so measuring the trade costs the trade nothing. The duplication of k and the control is the known cost of the tap (ADR 0003); b2-coupled-edge-live would remove it.
beta. W settles near F_in/beta, so beta sets both the smoothing window and the SCALE of W — and therefore the level of P. beta and alpha are not independent knobs (ADR 0003).
alpha x M / W. threshold floors the denominator at 0.01 rather than at GSSK_RATIO_EPSILON (1e-9), so an emptied W bounds the price instead of sending it to 1e11.
alpha x P. Same alpha as p_target — see _mechanism.
